nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for @waggle/optimizer, a thin wrapper around @ax-llm/ax that exposes typed one-shot LLM program primitives (summarizer, classifier, prompt_expander) consumed by the server's optimizer-service.ts. Clearly distinguishes this package from the evolution/GEPA stack in packages/agent/ and describes when to extend each system.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/optimizer (v0.1.0), declaring @ax-llm/ax as its sole dependency and exposing src/index.ts as the ESM entry point for one-shot Ax LLM programs.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for @waggle/optimizer targeting ES2022 with composite project settings, strict mode, and bundler module resolution, compiling from src/ to dist/.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses composite: true for TypeScript project references, enabling incremental builds and cross-package type checking in the monorepo.
